messages:
elaine: Quick mock — proposing a 'threshold slider' that lets users pick incident sensitivity from 'lenient' to 'strict' and also toggles per-channel overrides. Sketch: https://imgur.com/xyz (mock)
jon: I like the slider idea. Question: how do we show per-channel preview? a compact badge list next to the slider or a mini-preview pane?
tara: mini-preview pane feels heavier. badges with hover-to-preview could be lighter for density. also keyboard nav: can we tab into badges and press space to open preview?
pranav: For backend delta: per-channel overrides will need to merge policy precedence. Prefer explicit 'override' CTA that opens a modal.
elaine: What if badges are inline chips with a 3-dot menu -> 'preview' / 'override' ? keeps the main panel compact. :thinking:
jon: that works. Accessibility note: chips must have aria-expanded/aria-controls when they open previews. aria-bot: Reminder: Interactive chips should be reachable by keyboard and announced by screen readers.
aria-bot: (automated) a11y checklist: focus order, aria-labels for badges, color contrast for slider track and handles.
tara: Copy nit — change 'Strict' to 'High sensitivity' and 'Lenient' to 'Low sensitivity' to avoid loaded language.
pranav: UX question: when a per-channel override exists, do we show an inline pill 'overrides' or shadow the slider? I prefer a pill to indicate divergence.
elaine: Pill + tooltip seems good. Tooltip text: 'Channel-level override: uses custom thresholds for SMS.'
jon: One more thought — preview should show expected notify count graph for past 24h when you hover. Not full chart, tiny sparkline + tooltip with number.
aria-bot: (automated) color contrast check failed for slider handle color #b0b8ff on light theme.
tara: ok, change handle to #4a6cff. Also ensure focus ring is 3px for contrast.
jon: Frontend: i'll prototype with accessible buttons and role=menu for three-dot. i'll also add e2e test for keyboard flow.
pranav: Can we revisit mobile? Chips may wrap poorly on phone. Maybe allow collapsing badges into 'Channels (3)' button on narrow widths.
elaine: Good call. We'll do responsive: badges visible > 800px, collapsed button otherwise. I'll update the spec.
tara: LGTM. I'll add copy updates + a11y notes to the figma comments. :thumbsup:
elaine: thanks team — i'll push updated artboards and tag y'all. Thread closed unless new issues.
